contexts.text: Good to which truth was adjoined. Signified.
The Lord willed thus completely to adjoin mankind to Himself.
That the human essence shall be adjoined to the Divine. Signified.
Thought from the human, that it was adjoined. Signified.
The Lord's thought from the human that has more closely adjoined itself to the Divine. Signified.
That the merit of righteousness was adjoined to the Divine Rational. Signified. To place upon = to adjoin.
Divine, to which rational human things were adjoined. Signified.
Truth Divine, that it was to be adjoined to the Divine good of the Lord's Rational. Treated of. See AC 3030.
Adjunction to His own life. Signified. AC 3514.
(Adjunction distinguished from conjunction.)

Adjunction of natural truth from another source. Signified. To be weary of the life = no adjunction, namely of natural truth to rational truth, for where there is not adjunction the rational appears to have no life.
Truths not learned in order to be done, adjoin themselves to affections of evil and falsity.
The adjunction of the affections of truth by good. Signified. AC 4096, Explained.
When a man adjoins these Societies to himself he is in evil, but when they are adjoined to him by the Lord he is in good.
The various kinds of Spirits that are adjoined to man when he is being regenerated.
To adjoin = conjunction.
The process of the adjunction of Societies of Spirits and Angels to man by the Lord.
To go near = adjunction.
To pursue = the disposition to adjoin, and to overtake = adjunction.
Mediate adjunction. Signified.
Thus Spirits who are like himself can always be called forth from Hell and adjoined to a man who is in evil.
Adjunction. Signified.
He adjoined to himself scientifics of the natural. Signified. To go up with him = to adjoin to himself.
To join themselves to = to reinforce.
To call = to adjoin.
To take to = to adjoin.
To give to wife = to adjoin.
And then simple good Spirits were adjoined to them... such Spirits are also adjoined to men in the world who are inwardly devils. HH 295:2.
When the evil first come into the other life, they have good Spirits and Angels adjoined to them, as when they lived here. Explained.
Falsified truth is falsity not conjoined but adjoined to truth and ruling over it.
(The difference between appropriating falsity and adjoining it.)

Went up with them = that were adjoined... Truths and goods not genuine remain adjoined at the side. So also the Lord's Church among the Gentiles, who have not genuine truths, are in Heaven adjoined to those who are in genuine truths and goods.
Good adopts truths and adjoins them to itself.
Good from the spiritual adjoined to truth when in combat. Signified, Explained... To give to him for a woman = to adjoin good to truth.

Spiritual good cannot be conjoined to those who are in the externals of the Church from infancy, but only adjoined so long as they are in combat... Such can only be reformed by the adjunction of spiritual good when they are in combat, but still they do not retain it. AC 8983.
The honour of any function is only adjoined to the person, and what is adjoined is separate from the person.
Why there are also Spirits who communicate with Hell adjoined to man.
Such Spirits are adjoined to man as he himself is as to affection; but good Spirits are adjoined by the Lord, and evil Spirits are summoned by the man himself.
The Spirits who are adjoined to man have nothing in common with natural order.
To every man there are adjoined Angels from heaven and Spirits from Hell. NJHD 149:end.
From this it is evident that the Divine is not in man, but is adjoined to him.
All Spirits in the World of Spirits are adjoined to men. Explained.
The Angels notice that their conjunction with the Divine proceeding is of no other character than what may be called adjunction.
What is Divine cannot he appropriated to man as his, but it can be adjoined to him, and so appear as if it were his.
The Lord's presence with man is adjunction, thus conjunction by contiguity. Signified.
Divine truth is not united but adjoined to man; but the Divine of the Father is not adjoined, but united to the Lord's Human, as the soul to its own body.

There is not a conjunction into one (between married partners) but adjunction, near and close according to love, and (amounting) to contact with those who are in love truly conjugial; this adjunction may be called spiritual cohabitation.
Not that the Esse of God pre-exists, but because it enters the Essence as what is adjunctive cohering...
To this man there is adjoined an Angel from Heaven... to this, a Spirit from Hell adjoins himself...
Charity can be adjoined to a faith in three Persons, but never conjoined; and charity only adjoined to faith is merely natural, and is spurious.
His Divine Itself cannot be conjoined to man, but only adjoined; as light and sound cannot be conjoined to the eye and ear, but only adjoined to them... Life itself is adjoined to man, not conjoined.
